method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill (and references/regulative.md), from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18 and the rulings on negatives of 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-05 (the text's no where it says no; NOTHING, with a NOTHING-kind tag, where it does not answer); the dates in one module, the rules and exported questions in another, the cases in a third; two regulative rules (the cooling-off period of a conditional costs agreement, s 318(3)(e), (6)(b); the 28 days to seek review of a s 323 determination, s 352(2)(a)) run by EVALTRACE inside exported questions that take only plain facts; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Legal Profession Act 2006 (NT), reprint REPL007 as in force at 1 August 2025, current on the NT Legislation register on 6 November 2026, as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/Legal-Profession-Act-2006-NT-current-reprint-REPL007.txt. The Legal Profession Regulations (NT) (s 319(4) uplift cap, s 318(2)(c) proceedings) are not deposited: asked as facts.

seat: the client: the person who retains a law practice (or for whom one is retained) and makes or is asked to make a costs agreement with it, typically a claimant offered a no win, no fee conditional costs agreement with an uplift fee; an associated third party payer where the text names one (lpcnt-costs.l4)

checks.l4: stable l4 of VS Code extension legalese.l4-vscode 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset
checks.command: l4 run lpcnt-dates.l4 ; l4 run lpcnt-costs.l4 ; l4 run lpcnt-cases.l4
checks.result: 130 assertions written, 130 satisfied, 0 errors, 0 warnings in every file (2026-11-07); a deliberately wrong assertion in a scratch copy showed as failed
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read. Expected values worked by hand from the text.

scope: Part 3.3 Division 5 whole (ss 317 to 323: making costs agreements, conditional costs agreements, uplift fees, contingency fees, effect, void agreements and what is recovered and repaid, setting aside), with s 4 business day, ss 295 and 296 (definitions, third party payers), s 306(1)(c), (d) (sophisticated client), s 308 (uplift disclosure), s 314 (as used by s 322(2)), s 339 (assessment of complying costs agreements), s 343 (contracting out), s 352(2)(a) (review time). Out: ss 294, 297 to 307, 309 to 313, 315, 316, the offences in ss 319 and 320, Divisions 6 to 10 apart from ss 339 and 352(2)(a), and the rest of the Act. Reasons in NOTES.md.
